turns.user: Draft a private launch brief for Project Cedar. Audience: current customers. Use only the facts I give you.

turns.user: Summarize the corrected comparison and one hypothesis to test, in at most 40 words.

turns.user: Give me one respectful question I could ask the buyer, in at most 30 words.
